headline: Bitcoin is holding near $80,800 on Sunday evening in Asia as the US-Iran standoff drags on with no strike and no deal, ahead of a busy Fed week.

market.asOf: Bitcoin read from CoinMarketCap at about 11:56 UTC (18:56 Bangkok) on Sun 25 Oct. Ether and Solana are from Investing.com's report at about 04:54 UTC; their 24h changes are not shown this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 45 on CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed Index (0-100 scale), read about 12:00 UTC

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,800 as the US-Iran standoff drags on
stories.summary: There is still no US strike on Iran and no deal. Reports on Sunday say US military strike plans are ready, with timing focused on after the 3 November US midterm elections. Bitcoin dipped below $80,000 on Saturday and has recovered on Sunday.
points: US Central Command has strike options ready, with the focus on after the 3 Nov midterms, The Hill reports via Al Jazeera.
Iran's army says it shot down a US drone over Bandar Abbas on Sunday, per Iran International.
Saturday's low is reported differently: $79,146 (Investing.com) and about $79,200 (crypto.news).
Glassnode puts the average cost of bitcoin held by ETFs and treasury companies at $80,000-$81,500, per BeInCrypto, so prices are sitting near where many big buyers broke even.
Brent crude hit $117.3 a barrel on Fri 23 Oct, its highest since June 2022, per Anadolu Agency.

stories.title: Weekend DeFi hacks: Initia names a software bug, X100 attack still listed as ongoing
stories.summary: The Initia blockchain is still paused. It blames a bug in its MoveVM software engine and says a fix should be finished and audited within a few days, with no restart time yet. At X100, an attacker used borrowed money to take control of the protocol's voting "Senate" and drain its treasury.
points: Initia says about $2.7M was bridged out and swapped into 1,135.52 ETH, and that its own INIT token supply is not affected, per The Industry Spread.
X100 losses: about $4.85M in USDT, per Blockaid via CryptoTimes.
The attacker used a flash loan (money borrowed and repaid in one transaction) of about 1.94M USDT to take 2 of 3 Senate seats, per Bitcoin.com News.
The X token fell more than 96%, per CryptoTimes and Bitcoin.com News.

sources.label: The Industry Spread: Initia stays halted after MoveVM bug
Cointelegraph: Initia halts blockchain after exploit

stories.title: Big week ahead: Fed on Wednesday, $11B bitcoin options expiry Friday
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday and a large batch of monthly bitcoin options expires on Friday. US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, had a second day of outflows on Friday.
points: Fed: the range is 3.75-4.00%, and 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold, per Newsquawk.
Deribit's monthly bitcoin options expire Fri 30 Oct at 08:00 UTC (15:00 Bangkok): about $11.1B, per TokenPost's 22 Oct snapshot.
Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $137.9M on Fri 23 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT at -$110.3M, per Farside data via NewsBTC.
That followed about -$635.6M on Thu 22 Oct (NewsBTC) or -$635.5M (crypto.news).

sources.label: NewsBTC: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF flows, 23 Oct

briefs.title: Brazil votes today; crypto prediction markets favour Flávio Bolsonaro
briefs.summary: Polymarket gives Flávio Bolsonaro about 79.8% and Kalshi about 81% to beat Lula, while final polls are close. Brazil has banned election betting contracts and blocked both sites, per The Rio Times.

briefs.title: Binance sees its biggest hourly stablecoin outflow of October
briefs.summary: About 49.96M USDT left Binance in one hour on 24 Oct, a day when 46 of 50 major coins fell, per Startup Fortune.

briefs.title: Zcash down 25% in a month ahead of its NU7 upgrade
briefs.summary: ZEC is about $1,184. Its NU7 network upgrade is expected around 5 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Bitcoin moving onto exchanges
briefs.summary: 32,380 BTC moved onto exchanges, while CryptoQuant's one-year whale holdings measure improved from about -282K to about -39K BTC, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 267 BTC while spending $193M on share buybacks
briefs.summary: Strategy spent $193M buying back its own preferred shares but added only 267 BTC, per Investing.com.

calendar.note: Flávio Bolsonaro vs Lula. Final polls are close: Datafolha and Quaest both 51-49 for Flávio, per The Rio Times. Token unlocks: XPL ~$16.9M and COAI ~$5.1M (25th), SAHARA ~$1.3M (26th), per the unlock data on this page.

Consensus +0.6%, prior 0.0% (Trading Economics). At 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok): consumer confidence (consensus 80.5, prior 81.9, per The Rio Times) and new home sales (consensus 660,000, prior 684,000). Galaxy call 8:30am ET; Robinhood reports after the close (call 5:00pm ET, 04:00 Wed Bangkok).
Rate 2.75%. Views are split: Newsquawk and Admirals expect a hike to 3.00% and markets price it at about 75-85%; Westpac expects a pause, and The Rio Times calendar shows a hold as consensus.
Rate 2.25%. In a Reuters poll, 19 of 34 economists expect a hike to 2.50%. Earlier the same day the Bank of Thailand decides (about 14:00 Bangkok; rate 1.00%, hold expected).
Range 3.75-4.00%. In a Reuters poll, 94 of 100 economists expect a hold. Press conference 2:30pm ET. Microsoft (call 5:30pm ET) and Alphabet report after the close. Next Fed meeting: 8-9 Dec.

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (advance) and September PCE inflation
calendar.note: GDP: consensus differs, 3.0% (Newsquawk) and 3.2% (The Rio Times); prior 2.2%. PCE 3.6% y/y expected (prior 3.4%), core 3.1% (prior 3.0%), per Newsquawk. Weekly jobless claims: consensus 196,000, prior 194,000.
Deposit rate 2.50%; 70 of 73 economists in a Reuters poll expect no change.
Calls and webinars at 5:00pm ET; Coinbase holds a live Q&A on X and YouTube. Token unlocks the same day: FF ~$20.1M and CARDS ~$20.2M, per the unlock data on this page.
A hold at 1.25% is expected. The BoJ has no fixed release time, per Admirals.
About $11.1B with max pain at $78,000 in a 22 Oct snapshot (TokenPost). Max pain is not a price target.
Consensus +0.8%, prior +0.9% (Trading Economics). Chicago PMI at 9:45am ET: prior 58.8. Fed's Musalem speaks at 12:30pm ET (23:30 Bangkok).
